title: Jado Akbar Latheya Haye Zeen Uto
body:
Jado Akbar latheya haye zeen uto phuphiyan nay khaima chorr dita..
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Sub khaak sira wich pa pa ron paeyan jado zalim nay phal barchi da Akbar day jigar wich torr dita..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Akbar di akhri hichki tay Sughra diyan aasa muk gaeyan
Loko Akbar diyan tutdiyan saawa nay haye karbal cho qasid beemar da ronda pitda morr dita..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Ek veer lae cholay sitay nay ek lae sehra banwaya aay
Wah malika tu Sughra diyan aasa nu ek ek ker kay haye do veera’n day khoon day wich kyun rorr dita..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Zainab Kulsoom nay ro ro jay Akbar nu tahtal hanak bandha
Qurbani wang saja kay khaimeya cho saidaniya nay chan Laila da maqtal day pasay torr dita..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Haye sari zindagi sikdi rahi Sughra Akbar nu waikhan lae
Mar gae jeundi na waikh saki inj da haye ujri nu qismat nay Akbar veer day naal vichor dita..
